ModMetaData.name: Ebbbs Renew (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: Coolie - 1.6 adapted by Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
Nine forms of goo, brought forward to RimWorld 1.6. Nobody knows what an ebbb is. They really, really like cheese.
I am not the author of this mod. All nine creatures are Coolie's; all I did was the work needed to make them run on 1.6. Credit goes to them, mistakes in the update are mine. If they come back to it, or ask me to take this down, it comes down.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2817264755 - last supporting 1.5, last updated in July 2024. Abandoned, not withdrawn.
WHAT IT ADDS
Nine creatures: the ebbb, the beee, the crebbb, the drebbbd, the ebbberration, the ebbbomination, the goliebbb, the thrumebbb and the bebbbholder. Body sizes run from 0.2 to 4, market values from 10 to 2000, and trainability from Intermediate to Advanced.
They come with a flesh type of their own, their own body plan, their own blood, ebbb leather, and a horn off the thrumebbb.
WHAT CHANGED IN THE 1.6 UPDATE
One line, nine times. Wildness stopped being a field of RaceProperties in 1.6 and became a StatDef declared under statBases. The old form is not an error, it is simply never read, and the stat defaults to -1, outside the range the game uses - so every one of the nine tamed for almost nothing, whether it was written at 0.4 or at 1.
The author had already moved the ebbb's colour variants to vanilla alternateGraphics in their own 1.5 update, so only the leftover SkinSet file of the old system had to go, which nothing referenced any more.
Goliebbb also now displays as goliebbb instead of ebbb, matching its PawnKindDef. No balance value was changed.
COMPATIBILITY
Built-in support for A Dog Said... Animal Prosthetics 2: the nine species are placed in its animal categories, so they can receive prosthetics and bionics like the animals of the base game. The ebbb and the bebbbholder get the basic replacements, the crebbb, the ebbberration, the drebbbd and the goliebbb the simple prosthetics as well, and the beee, the ebbbomination and the thrumebbb the bionics too. There is nothing to install and nothing to configure, and without that mod the patch does nothing.
Content mod: removing it mid-save will lose any ebbb already in play, of any size.
The original states no licence anywhere - no file, nothing in its About, nothing in the README it ships, no repository, nothing on its Workshop page. This port therefore rests on the Workshop's own custom for abandoned mods: named credit to the author, and a takedown on request.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic).
